http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#com:
Dating / time span of a bb5kbc:KulturelleZuordnung.
URI: culture_{hash}_dating  (derived from parent KulturelleZuordnung hash).
One per Fundstelle. Dual superclass: time:Interval (for dating_start/end integers
via time:hasBeginning / time:hasEnd + time:inXSDgYear) and crm:E52_Time-Span
(for CIDOC CRM compatibility).
Properties:
  bb5kbc:datierungStart      xsd:integer  (dating_start, BP or BCE/CE)
  bb5kbc:datierungEnd        xsd:integer  (dating_end)
  bb5kbc:datierungMethode    → bb5kbc:DatierungsMethodeType (dating_method QID)
  bb5kbc:datierungSicherheitStart  xsd:string  (dating_certainty_start)
  bb5kbc:datierungSicherheitEnd    xsd:string  (dating_certainty_end)
  bb5kbc:datierungSicherheitRange  xsd:string  (dating_certainty_range, e.g. 'ca.')
  skos:exactMatch / skos:closeMatch / skos:relatedMatch → Perio.do URI
    (dating_perio.do + dating_perio.do_match determine which SKOS property)
